exclude_reason: No upstream PR fixes the defect, and the composition is not a fold-in. #99042 (the only upstream PR, Closes #99032) checks for orphaned labels at dispatch time, while the tokens still exist, so it fails all 6 regression cases on 298a01c7. It is also red at its own head: PASTE_SNIPPET_RE is a global regex and looksLikeOrphanedPasteToken calls .test() on it, so lastIndex carries over and every second consecutive orphan is missed (3 of its 22 tests fail), and the new `unresolved` key breaks main's useSubmission.test.ts. With the regex fixed, its block refuses every queue-edit resubmit of a collapsed paste, including the /queue-item edit main delivers today. On its own drain path it dequeues a busy queue-mode paste and refuses it while telling the user 'nothing is lost'. The whole fix is kvnloo's unpublished branch ready/fork-56-queued-paste-payload (6/6, clean merge, 239/239 adjacent, negative controls fire), which would be the entire production change (+53/-31, 5 files), not a fold-in onto #99042. Becomes a row once fork-56 is opened upstream as the carrier (see row_when_opened), after kvnloo coordinates on #99032 with kokhlo, who claimed the issue on 2026-08-31.
